ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: This is a hand-drawn food web, with Plants, Rodent, Maggot, Scorpion, Bird of Prey, Bird, Hunter, Scavenger, etc. labeled in the diagram. The arrows indicate the direction from food/prey to consumer/predator. It can be seen that there is an arrow from Maggot to Scorpion, and another arrow from Scorpion to Bird of Prey. Reasoning: The arrow from Maggot to Scorpion shows that the scorpion preys on the maggot and is a predator. The arrow from Scorpion to Bird of Prey shows that the scorpion is preyed on by the bird of prey and is prey. Therefore, in this food web, the one that is both a predator and prey is Scorpion.
